essence: Bhīṣma embodies supreme Śaiva knowledge, pedagogical authority, and fiery divinity.
Bhīṣma is characterized by formidable presence and unwavering commitment to celibacy.
The primordial king is a paternal ruler who makes the earth abundantly bountiful.
The supreme emperor combines world-nourishing rule with fearsome martial power.
The ruler enacts, teaches, and establishes the duties of social and religious order.
